original_review_finding.trigger: An original acknowledged order is terminal with filled quantity 0 and final fee 0; account snapshot rebase has released old reservations. A later matched original observation reports a legal partial fill, e.g. quantity 1 of 3 at average 19 below original BUY limit 20.
original_review_finding.before_fix: The pure verifier flags only local row inconsistencies. This in-range row needs_reconciliation=False; journal stores FACTS_ONLY without comparing current terminal/epoch/cumulative records, leaving risk reasons empty.
original_review_finding.effect: The original trusted economic values are correctly not overwritten, but a new claim can proceed against the previously reconciled baseline despite newly contradictory retained evidence.
original_review_finding.minimum_fix: Compare retained observation/fee facts against current original claim cumulative values, terminal state and epoch. Preserve original values and require explicit reconciliation for material contradictions; never book quantity-times-average as exact notional or manufacture fee currency/finality.
original_review_finding.additional_case: A later actual fee amount differing from an already-final recorded fee must also block new risk while retaining original finality/value.

positive_review: ACTION stored result/payload bytes remain unchanged; receipt_id/recorded_at are derived from verified event during replay.
Foreign self-sealed ACTION cannot enter journal: actual operation and original receipt_id are matched.
Late ACK requires prior UNKNOWN evidence ID and original frame; known sent bytes are preserved.
Cancel ACK is not terminal; API error/missing order ID remain UNKNOWN and do not release fees/reservations.
Raw funds/position/order/fee projections are not admitted as cash/owner positions/exact fills/final fees.
coverage_note: At initial review the integration file had 15 cases. It covered over-limit fill diagnostics and contradictory ACK, but not an in-range late fill after terminal+rebase or changed final fee.
root_response: Root acknowledged and is adding cross-record comparison and focused regressions before fullgate/probe. This file is the pre-fix finding, not a post-fix approval.
